text:
Ava Morgan: Heads up — there's an ABI bump landing in runtime v3.5.0 that affects kernel symbols used by quantized kernels. Need to lock in a deploy window + pin/rollback plan.

Devon Lee: timeline? is this tied to the q4_0 quant artifacts we've been testing?

Mira Patel: yes, q4_0 artifacts were built against the new kernel ABI. If we deploy v3.5.0 without a staged rollout, old quant runtimes may crash with undefined symbol errors.

Samir Rao: Proposed plan: canary to 5% (non-critical region) for 30m with autoscale disabled, health-checks include kv-cache hit rate + model-inference error-rate. If stable -> 25% for 1h -> 100% in change window. Pin images for fallback.

Ava Morgan: change window suggestion: 02:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow to hit lower traffic. @ops-oncall will be oncall for the window.

ops-oncall: Confirmed, I'm available. Will monitor SLO dashboards + set up a quick pager if error-rate > 1% for 5m.

Sylvia Chen: Rollback knobs we need documented here:
```
# pin runtime to previous GA
redwoodctl pin service/runtime --version=v3.4.2 --reason="rollback ABI bump"
# abort rollout
redwoodctl rollout abort --id=<rollout-id>
# revert quant artifacts if needed
artifacts/quant/release/set-default q4_0 v2026-03-12
```

Samir Rao: Also add a hotfix path: if ABI break can't be resolved quickly we fallback the entire fleet to v3.4.2 and return quant artifacts to pre-ABI builds. That buys time for a binary-compatible rebuild.

ci-bot: CI status: build/runtime:v3.5.0-abi1 -> tests: unit ✅ integration ✅ canary-smoke ❌

Mira Patel: canary-smoke failing due to symbol lookup error in linalg kernel on p3 instances. Local repro steps attached to PR #842. Fix is small but needs a rebuild of kernel shared object with symbol aliasing.

Devon Lee: Given the failing smoke, I'd prefer to hold the wide rollout until fix merged. Can we still schedule the change window and gate the final step on canary-smoke passing?

Ava Morgan: Yes — schedule window so we have the slot, but only hand off to deployment if canary-smoke passes and the first 30m are green. If not green, we abort and pin back.

Samir Rao: I'll prepare the rollback playbook in runbook format and put steps in the incident doc. Quick checklist:
- who: @ops-oncall (primary), @Devon Lee (infra), @Mira Patel (runtime)
- commands: see Sylvia's snippet
- monitoring: SLO dashboard link (observers only)
- postmortem owner: Samir

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled by @Ava Morgan -> 2026-03-21 02:00:00 UTC to 2026-03-21 06:00:00 UTC. Canary cutoff: 5% for 30m. Rollout can be resumed with `deploy-bot resume <id>` when checks pass.

Ava Morgan: For extra safety, we'll pin dependent services to accept both ABIs during the transition where possible (symbol shims). Mira, can runtime package include the shim in the build?

Mira Patel: Yes, I'll add a shim build variant `runtime:v3.5.0-shim` and attach it to the canary group as a fallback image. It will be built after the fix is merged.

Devon Lee: Ops note — autoscaling will be disabled during the first two stages to avoid spiky behavior during health failures. Also we'll set circuit-breaker to failover to dedicated tier.

Samir Rao: Posting final rollout checklist below for handoff:
```
1) Confirm CI green (canary-smoke ✅)
2) deploy-bot start rollout --image=runtime:v3.5.0-abi1 --canary=5%
3) wait 30m, run health checks (errors < 0.5%, latency within SLO)
4) if green -> canary=25% for 60m -> then 100% in window
5) any failure -> redwoodctl pin service/runtime v3.4.2 + deploy-bot abort
```

ops-oncall: I'll create the dedicated monitoring channel and invite infra & runtime leads.

Ava Morgan: Great. I'll hold the change window and update the release note: "runtime v3.5.0 — ABI bump, kernel shim available, quant q4_0 compatibility; canary + rollback plan included."

deploy-bot: Rollout prepared. To start manually: `deploy-bot start <prepared-rollout-id>`. Scheduled window reserved. :white_check_mark:

Devon Lee: Thanks everyone. I'll standby for the canary-smoke fix PR, if merged and CI passes we'll kick off per the checklist.

Mira Patel: PR #847 opened with symbol aliasing fix. Rebuild running.

ci-bot: build/runtime:v3.5.0-abi1 -> canary-smoke ✅ (rebuild #42)

Samir Rao: All green — proceeding to start canary in the reserved window unless new objections.

Ava Morgan: No objections. Starting canary at 02:00 UTC. Please be ready on pager.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: id=r-20260321-0001, canary=5%. Monitoring hooks active.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Monitoring channel created: #incident-runtime-abi-bump.

Sylvia Chen: Copy. I'll standby for a rollback command if needed.

Ava Morgan: Thanks team — will update this thread with status ticks during the window.
